title: Illegal Vehicle Properties
description: Schema for illegal vehicle detection events. Captures vehicle view information, zone identification, and violation type for enforcement monitoring and restricted area analytics.

vehicle_view.description: Describes the detected vehicle view perspective (e.g., Front, Rear, Side). Used for identification and enforcement evidence.

zoneid.description: Identifier of the restricted or monitored zone where the illegal vehicle was detected.

type.description: Specifies the category or type of illegal vehicle violation detected.
